status_note: the pin is the head of the fork branch claude/project-thread-8i686d (moeendres-png/mage), three engine commits on the v10 pin 769e6ebb: the Protector of the Wastes trigger fix (the trigger read the event source instead of the entering permanent and ended a precon pod in an engine NullPointerException), Tempt with Reflections creating its copies in table order instead of identity-hash order, and the lazy trigger copy of a playable-calculation game copy (the copy takes the triggers of its parent on first use). The same seed still replays the same game: with and without the trigger commit 46 of 46 precon pods and 36 of 36 seeds give identical semantic hashes, and the 36 seeds also equal those of the v10 pin. The lazy trigger copy saves about 3 to 6 percent of the CPU time of a sweep. The perf port (0c0132a2ef) stays out of the pin because it changes option text. The candidate branch claude/xmage-mp-candidate-20260929 is fast-forwarded to the pin with the Owner's go (2026-10-21 18:34 UTC). The native maven.yml run on the exact commit and the Lab bridge suite are bound under native_qualification and lab_runtime_qualification; current_boundary keeps its repin-time status REQUALIFICATION_REQUIRED.
